reference.method: Execute pinned browser TypeScript. Engine vector/clip storage is stubbed; timings come from pinned shipped glTF. No native controller is imported.
reference.scope: Numerical behavior only. Not evidence for OS mouse capture, collisions in the current world, real bone poses, GUI rendering or target-PC FPS.
intentional_safety_exceptions: Do not restore full motor reset on ordinary cancel while airborne.
Do not collapse blocked ranged attack distance to 0.1.
Keep authoritative server, saved data and current Godot world/assets. The old gateway only logged local commands.

simulation.presentation: previous + (current - previous) * clock.alpha; one physics tick of interpolation, no network buffer in the browser reference

input.browser_rmb: Pointer capture; movementX/Y accumulated per render. No Pointer Lock, hidden cursor or OS warp.

monster_ai.safety_exception: Native lifecycle and target identity guards intentionally remain; the old !alive branch regressed corpse state to dead.
